title: Business Analyst (Multi-Country Digital Bank Builder)
jobDescription:
About the job

Are you an innovative Business Analyst looking to make an impact in the Digital Bank domain? We want you! Join Our Team: Revolutionize Digital Banks with Cutting-Edge Technology

Who We Are:

At TymeX, we are at the forefront of building and operating multi-country digital banks. Our mission is to revolutionize the financial services industry through technology, creating seamless and secure payment solutions that change the way people interact with money.

The Middle/Senior Business Analyst (Multi-Country Digital Bank Builder) will play a key part in the establishment and building of a new business. This business will act as a centralized hub providing digital solutions and application development across the TYME's business. You will bring a passion for meeting the needs of individuals and businesses through a range of banking products as well as a deep understanding of the benefits that technology can bring to customers' daily lives.

Top 5 Reasons Why We Are the Next Destination for Your Career 


 Innovation-Driven Environment: Work with the latest technologies including Serverless aspects of AWS Cloud, AI-augmented engineering, microservices, Java, and Python
 Impactful Work: Contribute to projects that directly influence financial inclusivity and access in emerging markets
 Collaborative Culture: Be part of a dynamic team that values collaboration, continuous learning, and personal growth
 Competitive Benefits: Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, opportunities for professional development, and a supportive work-life balance
 Learning and Development: Access to SMART goals, technical seminars, conferences, career talks, and overseas training to accelerate your career advancement and ensure continuous growth


Your Mission:


Work with our people and partners across our Business, Product, Design and Data teams to understand the customer needs and define the functional requirements for our global banking products
You will bring your financial services and technology experience to facilitate the solutioning process with our world class Product Engineering teams
A successful mission will include (1) defining solutions that solve for the big picture and long-term success of the Group (2) Balancing technical challenges with business needs, as a key voice alongside our Product and Engineering teams to manage backlogs and priorities
Execute our ‘multi-X' strategy. Defining solutions for one bank is one thing, applying your mind to solving for replication strategies across multiple countries is what sets a TymeX career apart from the rest


Requirements


Your profile:
To be successful at this role we are looking for experts who possess:
At least 5 years working as a dedicated Business Analyst
Hands-on experience in building products, features and services in the banking and financial services sector
Well-seasoned Business Analyst competencies and skillset, including but not limited to logical, critical, analytical thinking and problem solving
A curious mindset. Our company is built by people who challenge the status quo and value exponential over incremental change
Experience working closely with Product, Technology and Development teams in a rapidly evolving and dynamic environment
Proficient in English, across writing, reading, speaking, and listening


Benefits


Meal and parking allowance are covered by the company
Full benefits and salary rank during probation
Performance-based bonus and equity participation in GoTyme Group
Insurances as Vietnamese labor law and premium health care for you and your family without seniority compulsory
Performance bonus up to 2 months
13th month salary pro-rata
15-day annual leave+ 3-day sick leave + 1 birthday leave + 1 Christmas leave
SMART goals and clear career opportunities (technical seminar, conference, and career talk) - we focus on your development
Values-driven, international working environment, and agile culture
Overseas travel opportunities for training and working related
Internal Hackathons and company's events (team building, coffee run, blue card...)
Work-life balance 40-hr per week from Mon to Fri


Beside the tangible benefits, we promise you the opportunity to:


Work with a best-in-class BA community who practice the latest methodologies and work with the latest technologies in banking
Explore a professional career path that will grow your skillset as a Business Analyst and provide you with the opportunity to work with a diverse range of people, products and problems
Work on the forefront of the digital banking sector as we scale to meet our vision of being a global leader in multi-country digital banking

title: Middle Business Analyst (Jira, outsourcing experience, acrossed multiple domains)
company: Digital Unicorn - Agence développement informatique internationale
jobDescription:
About the job

About Digital Unicorn:

Office Address: 3F, No 22-24 Ung Van Khiem, Thanh My Tay Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam




Digital Unicorn is a mobile and web development agency focused on creating great digital products that truly matter to our customers. We work closely with startups, scale-ups, and established companies to design and build high-quality applications with strong product thinking, clean execution, and long-term value in mind. Our team is international, highly motivated, and hands-on. We value ownership, clarity, and craftsmanship. We keep things practical, move fast, and expect everyone to contribute directly to the success of our projects and our clients.

We believe great products come from people who care deeply about users, quality, and collaboration.




About the Role:

Level: Junior+, Middle

Type: Onsite, Fulltime, In-house

We are looking for a Business Analyst to join our growing delivery team and work on high-impact client projects.

You will be involved in building, improving, and maintaining real-world products used by real users. At any given time, you will focus on the most important product or technical challenge for your project.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys taking responsibility, working closely with PMs, designers, and other engineers, and turning ideas into reliable, well-crafted software.




REQUIREMENTS:

2-4 years of solid experience (a must) as a Business Analyst in software or digital projects, (prefer outsourcing experience, acrossed multiple domains)
Clear and concise English communication skills, both written and spoken
Experience working in software outsourcing companies, consulting environment, 
A strong sense of ownership and responsibility for your work
Strong knowledge of Agile and Scrum frameworks
Ability to use common BA tools (e.g., process modeling tools, requirements management tools, documentation platforms).
Strong understanding of modern software architecture and best practices
Proficient in creating and managing BRD, SRS, and product documentation
Good product sense: you care about how users experience what you build
Ability to prioritise, work independently, and deliver reliably
Comfortable working in a fast-moving, client-focused environment
Ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset




RESPONSIBILITIES:

Design, build, and maintain mobile or web applications with a strong focus on product quality and user experience
Work closely with product owners, project managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver features end-to-end
Take ownership of features or technical areas, from concept to production
Identify performance, stability, or usability issues and fix them proactively
Communicate clearly about progress, risks, and technical decisions




BENEFIT:

Open to discuss about Salary & bonus, aligned with your skills and experience
100% salary during the probation period
Insurance coverage according to local regulations
Work on real products with real impact
Project ownership – make meaningful contributions from day one
Learn from experienced engineers, PMs, and managers
Grow your technical and product skills quickly
International working environment, English-speaking environment with direct client exposure
A culture that values quality, responsibility, and continuous improvement
Dynamic, comfortable, and creative working environment
Team building events & company trips every year, Happy Hour every Friday
Snacks and fresh fruits always available for your break times
Sports & wellness activities to recharge and boost energy




If you are interested in, please feel free to submit your CV!

title: Senior Business Analyst - Insurance, Claims (Hybrid)
jobDescription:
About the job

Top 3 Reasons To Join Us


Competitive Salary
International Environment
Working on the latest tech for the Insurtech Market Leader


About Us

At CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone.


We are a leading global no-code insurance platform for health, life, and P&C
We're the winner of the Insurtech of the Year in all of Asia and other awards globally
We work with insurance enterprise clients such as AXA, Bupa, MSIG, Dai-ichi, Bank of China Group Insurance, and many more
We're an international, diverse team of over 120 people with 30 nationalities and team members working remotely from all over the world
We are fully funded and backed by reputable VC funds and strategic institutional investors
We have a global presence in Asia, EMEA and the Americas
We've grown our annualized revenue by over 30x since January 2021
We're constantly working towards making CoverGo a workplace that you love coming to. We deeply believe that bringing together a diversity of thoughts, expressions, and perspectives is key to building the best culture for equally diverse communities all over the world


What You Will Do:


Work with clients and technical resources to identify their business problems and develop the right approach and analytical solution
Plan and design simple to semi-complex business processes and system modifications
Make recommendations to improve and support business activities
Gather business requirements through a variety of techniques such as work sessions and interviews then analyze and document client complex business requirements and processes; communicate these requirements to appropriate parties
Create complex test case scenarios to be used in testing; monitor/oversee the testing of business applications to verify that all client requirements are incorporated into the system design
Develop business requirements documents/user stories to support the required modifications
May plan, allocate and monitor work of other business analysts
Understand simple to complex systems and related data to surface actionable insights, demonstrate sound judgment and decision-making skills
Assist in providing time estimates for project related tasks
Aid in updating process and procedural documentation
Develop basic understanding of technical development cycle of mobile application or web portals
Support QA, UAT and Release phases of the project via defect analysis, change maintenance, etc
Any other task that may be assigned


What We Need:


Minimum 5 years of experience as Business Analyst
A degree in Business, IT or any relevant field
Previous experience working in the insurance industry is required (Insurtech or health insurance experience is preferred)
Health Insurance-related domain certification from INS/LOMA or III is an added advantage
Knowledge of business analysis concepts of defining requirements, translating to technical solutions, and Agile approach to prioritizing work to epics, sprints
Business analysis skills including facilitation, process documentation, requirements gathering and user acceptance testing
Good organizational/time management skills to prioritize work and meet deadlines within defined timeframes
Experience in an Agile and/or Scrum environment is a must
Basic knowledge in generating process documentation, and document system functionality, data integration, and workflow
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Currently based in Vietnam 


Why You'll Love Working Here


Flexible Leave
International Environment
Competitive renumeration package
Performance Bonus
Company activities and events
Learning and development plan
Annual Health Check-up


CoverGo Company Video

By submitting your application, you confirm that you have read, understood, and accepted the content of CoverGo's Privacy Notice and you consent to the processing of your data as part of this application.

jobDescription:
About the job

Top 3 Reasons To Join Us


Competitive Salary
International Environment
Working on the latest tech for the Insurtech Market Leader


About Us

At CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone.


We are a leading global no-code insurance platform for health, life, and P&C
We're the winner of the Insurtech of the Year in all of Asia and other awards globally
We work with insurance enterprise clients such as AXA, Bupa, MSIG, Dai-ichi, Bank of China Group Insurance, and many more
We're an international, diverse team of over 120 people with 30 nationalities and team members working remotely from all over the world
We are fully funded and backed by reputable VC funds and strategic institutional investors
We have a global presence in Asia, EMEA and the Americas
We've grown our annualized revenue by over 30x since January 2021
We're constantly working towards making CoverGo a workplace that you love coming to. We deeply believe that bringing together a diversity of thoughts, expressions, and perspectives is key to building the best culture for equally diverse communities all over the world


What You Will Do:


Work with clients and technical resources to identify their business problems and develop the right approach and analytical solution
Plan and design simple to semi-complex business processes and system modifications
Make recommendations to improve and support business activities
Gather business requirements through a variety of techniques such as work sessions and interviews then analyze and document client complex business requirements and processes; communicate these requirements to appropriate parties
Create complex test case scenarios to be used in testing; monitor/oversee the testing of business applications to verify that all client requirements are incorporated into the system design
Develop business requirements documents/user stories to support the required modifications
May plan, allocate and monitor work of other business analysts
Understand simple to complex systems and related data to surface actionable insights, demonstrate sound judgment and decision-making skills
Assist in providing time estimates for project related tasks
Aid in updating process and procedural documentation
Develop basic understanding of technical development cycle of mobile application or web portals
Support QA, UAT and Release phases of the project via defect analysis, change maintenance, etc
Any other task that may be assigned


What We Need:


Minimum 4 years of experience as Business Analyst
A degree in Business, IT or any relevant field
Previous experience working in the insurance industry is required (Insurtech or health insurance experience is preferred)
Health Insurance-related domain certification from INS/LOMA or III is an added advantage
Knowledge of business analysis concepts of defining requirements, translating to technical solutions, and Agile approach to prioritizing work to epics, sprints
Business analysis skills including facilitation, process documentation, requirements gathering and user acceptance testing
Good organizational/time management skills to prioritize work and meet deadlines within defined timeframes
Experience in an Agile and/or Scrum environment is a must
Basic knowledge in generating process documentation, and document system functionality, data integration, and workflow
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Currently based in Vietnam 


Why You'll Love Working Here


Flexible Leave
International Environment
Competitive renumeration package
Performance Bonus
Company activities and events
Learning and development plan
Annual Health Check-up

title: Principal Accelerator (Business Analyst/Scrum Product Owner)
locationDetails: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
jobDescription:
About the job

Principal Accelerator (Business Analyst/Scrum Product Owner)

Ho Chi Minh

Tech/Engineer

TOP 3 REASONS TO JOIN US


Perks you will love: Hybrid woring; 16 - 24 paid days off; Top modern & sufficient devices
Solid global business: No.1 market - 13.7 million B2C users in Japan; 140,000+ paying business customers; Listed in the prime market of Tokyo Stock Exchange
Hub of growth support: Fintech industry; Tailored L&D programs for individual growth


Job Description

This is a very challenging and exciting position for anyone who would like to learn and work in various fields such as:


Requirement Analysis
Product backlog management
Linguistic
Support Testing


Joining as an Accelerator in MFV, you will have the chance to play multiple roles:


Scrum Product Owner
IT Communicator


In addition, you will have the opportunity to cooperate with different departments so that you can improve your main skills and figure out your potential abilities as well.

About The Roles For This Position


Manage the Product Backlog properly to ensure that the development team members have a clear understanding of their product development initiatives and their delivery.
Support communication between the Japan and Vietnam teams.
Facilitate meetings.
Translate all kinds of work-related documents (Japanese/English).
Interpret whenever required.


This role expects a strong security mindset, with a clear understanding of data privacy, credential protection, device security, and the responsible use of corporate systems, tools, and accounts.

Requirements

Must Have


Experience with Scrum development methodologies.
Language proficiency: Japanese (JLPT N2 or higher); English (TOEIC score of 850 or higher, or IELTS score of 6.5 or higher).
At least 2 years of experience as an IT communicator.
High level of proficiency in time management, stakeholder management, and critical thinking.


Nice to Have


Possession of either a Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO) certification


Our benefits

Caring Mental & Physical Recreation


Hybrid working: 2 days at the office and 3 days WFH
Working hour: Flexible start 8AM-9AM from Mon-Fri
Full salary in probation
Insurance: Applied from Probation period:
Social Insurance, Health Insurance, Unemployment Insurance (on 100% salary)
Private health insurance & accident insurance. From Managing level: extra for family members
Bonus: 13th month salary
16 - 24 paid days off and more
Paternity leave: Extra 5 days
Annual company trip; Quarterly team building
Billiards & Running club
Annual health check
Well-equipped facility: Macbook pro, additional monitor,..

Caring Career & Development


Clear Career path
Foreign language & International technology-related certifications sponsoring
External & internal training courses
Soft-skill workshops
Tech seminars
Monthly and biannual Recognition Awards
Performance & salary review: twice/year (Jun & Dec)

We are looking for strong experienced Business Analysts who will join in our amazing team and work with client to understand their business need about product in E-commerce, E-wallet and Fintech, etc. Your key responsibilities are:

Attend requirement daily meeting with customer to understand the business
Break down the requirement to user stories with Acceptance Criteria
Join scrum team grooming to explain user stories for developers
Collaborate with internal teams to conduct UAT and release product features to client
Conduct sprint review with customer by demo the completed features

At least 4+ years of experience in Business Analyst or Product Executive/Owner
Experience in Fintech, Cryptocurrency is a plus
Experience working in Agile/Scrum methodology

jobDescription:
About the job

About Us: Noventiq (Noventiq Holdings PLC) is a premier global provider of cutting-edge digital transformation and cybersecurity solutions, headquartered in London. We empower businesses to thrive in the digital age, connecting them with top-tier IT vendors and delivering our own innovative services and proprietary solutions.

Why Noventiq? Our success is driven by a robust three-dimensional strategy focused on expanding our market presence, diversifying our product portfolio, and enhancing our sales channels. Through strategic M&A activities, we are poised to capitalize on industry consolidation and achieve unprecedented growth. With a dynamic team of approximately 6,400 employees operating in around 60 countries, we have a significant footprint in regions with immense growth potential, including Latin America, EMEA, APAC, and a notable presence in India.

Your Opportunity: Join a globally recognized organization, celebrated with multiple "Great Place to Work" awards. At Noventiq, your ideas matter. We foster an environment where innovation thrives and collaboration is a cornerstone. Be a part of our journey to drive digital transformation worldwide.

Ready to Make an Impact? If you're passionate about shaping the future of digital transformation and cybersecurity, we want you on our team. Join us and be a part of a global organization where your contributions are valued and your potential is limitless. Join us today!

Now we’re looking for Senior Business Analyst to bring your talent to Noventiq Vietnam. You’ll be a part of our Services Delivery Team.

What You’ll Do

 Requirement & Analysis 


 Run discovery sessions with stakeholders to identify pain points and opportunities 
 Write clear SRS / BRD suitable for both business and development teams 
 Create prototypes, mockups, and wireframes to validate with customers before build 


Delivery Support


 Validate design and technical feasibility with development team 
 Prepare test scenarios, coordinate UAT, manage defect resolution 
 Support go-live and hypercare — troubleshoot issues, coach end-users 


Stakeholder Management


 Single point of contact on business matters for assigned customers 
 Manage change requests — evaluate impact, prioritize, communicate trade-offs 


Documentation & Training


 Prepare end-user training materials and user guides 
 Contribute reusable templates and playbooks to the BA practice 


About You

Must-have


 5+ years BA experience in IT / software delivery 
 3+ enterprise projects with large corporate customers (1000+ employees) 
 Proven SRS / BRD writing at production quality 
 Microsoft ecosystem exposure: M365, SharePoint, Teams, or Power Platform 
 Excellent Vietnamese; strong technical English 


What We Offer


Working time: Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm; flexible working time
Attractive Bonus, & Allowances for mobile, transportation, parking
Premium Healthcare insurance
External and Internal Training Opportunities & English class are sponsored by company
Birthday paid day-off & Birthday gift
Recognition program, Referral program
Working device provided or reimbursement on personal device
Other activities: annual company trip, year-end dinner, exciting engagement events, Coaching opportunities, etc.
Annual Salary Review & Promotion


Don’t forget to include your CV with a photo and cover letter. We receive a lot of applications, and we try to notice each of our potential candidates.

title: Business Analyst (AI/ERP Domain)
locationDetails: Nhà Bè, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
jobDescription:
About the job
Senior Business Analyst (Business BA) for AI Platform Reports to: AI Specialist Lead Context We are developing a shared AI platform for the business units of a multi-industry group in Vietnam (banking, aviation, consumer finance, real estate). The platform supports building and operating AI agents for business work: attaching tools, loading internal documents, and orchestrating multiple agents that work together. This role owns the business side of the requirement: what the business needs and why. Responsibilities • Work with the AI Specialist to translate stakeholder requirements into a Business Requirement Document (BRD). • Act as the bridge between the AI Specialist team and Dev: facilitate meetings & track open questions. • Perform gap analysis (as-is vs. to-be) and document process flows using Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) / Swimlane notation. • Write User Stories (US) and define Definition of Ready (DoR) for all US entering the sprint. • Coordinate with the AI Specialist and AI Dev team during solution design to make sure the business intent is preserved. • Understand the business products the platform serves (knowledgable in banking and financial products is a plus); be able to speak the stakeholders' language. • Experience building or maintaining user-facing guidelines/manuals for a software product. Requirements • Minimum 3-5 years as a Business Analyst, consultant, or equivalent. • Experience with banking or financial products. • Experience with web/app products. • Comfortable writing BRDs, User Stories, and acceptance criteria that a technical team can pick up without re-interpretation. • Working knowledge of BPMN / Swimlane process modelling. • Good written and spoken English. Preferred • Prior exposure to AI/GenAI products.

title: Business Analyst - Non Lending MSME Product
locationDetails: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
jobDescription:
About the job

Mục tiêu công việc 


Đóng vai trò phân tích kinh doanh cho các giải pháp Quản lý dòng tiền MSME, tập trung vào việc tìm hiểu nhu cầu khách hàng, phân tích dữ liệu kinh doanh, xác định cơ hội tăng trưởng và hỗ trợ Product Owner xây dựng các giải pháp mang lại giá trị cho khách hàng và ngân hàng. 


Trách nhiệm chính 


Phân tích nhu cầu, hành vi và khó khăn của khách hàng MSME trong việc quản lý dòng tiền và vận hành doanh nghiệp. 
Phân tích dữ liệu giao dịch, CASA, doanh thu phí và mức độ sử dụng sản phẩm để xác định cơ hội cải thiện hiệu quả kinh doanh. 
Xây dựng các báo cáo, dashboard và business insight phục vụ việc ra quyết định của Product Owner và các bên liên quan. 
Thu thập, làm rõ và quản lý các yêu cầu nghiệp vụ từ Business, Sales, Operations và khách hàng. 
Hỗ trợ xây dựng customer journey, business requirements và mô hình vận hành cho các giải pháp mới. 
Thực hiện phân tích thị trường, đánh giá đối thủ và đề xuất các tính năng hoặc sáng kiến phù hợp với phân khúc MSME. 
Xây dựng business case, đánh giá lợi ích kinh doanh và đo lường hiệu quả sau triển khai. 
Phối hợp với các đơn vị liên quan trong quá trình triển khai và vận hành sản phẩm. 


Yêu cầu 


Tối thiểu 7 năm kinh nghiệm trong các lĩnh vực SME Banking, Portfolio Management, Transaction Banking, Business Analytics, Sales Effectiveness hoặc Consulting. 
Có khả năng phân tích dữ liệu, nhận diện insight và chuyển hóa thành đề xuất kinh doanh. 
Hiểu biết về hoạt động thanh toán, quản lý dòng tiền hoặc vận hành doanh nghiệp là một lợi thế. 
Thành thạo Excel, Power BI, Tableau hoặc các công cụ phân tích dữ liệu tương đương. 
Kỹ năng giao tiếp, trình bày và làm việc với nhiều bên liên quan tốt. 
Có tư duy phân tích, tư duy giải quyết vấn đề và định hướng kết quả kinh doanh.

🎯 BẠN SẼ LÀM GÌ? Phân tích nghiệp vụ (BA): Phối hợp chặt chẽ với stakeholders tại Singapore để thu thập yêu cầu, phân tích quy trình và xây dựng các tài liệu chuẩn mực (BRD, FSD, User Stories, Wireframes).Quản lý dự án (PM): Lên kế hoạch và điều phối dự án theo mô hình Agile/Scrum, quản lý tiến độ, hỗ trợ UAT và đảm bảo bàn giao sản phẩm đúng hạn, đúng phạm vi.Dẫn dắt đội ngũ: Trực tiếp định hướng, phân công và kiểm soát chất lượng cho team công nghệ tại Việt Nam (gồm 2-3 Lập trình viên/QA).Làm chủ sản phẩm: Làm việc cùng team UI/UX để tối ưu trải nghiệm người dùng, đánh giá giải pháp kỹ thuật và liên tục nâng cấp nền tảng HealthTech.

title: Network Strategy & Solution Analyst, Associate - Operations, Shopee
locationDetails: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
jobDescription:
About the job

Job Description

Job summary:

We are looking for a Network Strategy & Solutions - Associate to work on network-level problem solving and solution implementation across Shopee’s large-scale logistics network.

This role focuses on addressing end-to-end and structural network performance issues rather than day-to-day operational problems. You will work on complex, ambiguous topics related to lead time, cost, and capacity, using data and structured thinking to design solutions and help drive them through execution.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving hard problems, connecting the dots across systems, and seeing ideas turn into real impact at scale.

What You Will Do


Analyze network performance data to identify patterns, issues, and improvement opportunities.
Involve in the design of network-level solutions by breaking down problems into key drivers.
Turning solutions into clear action plans and supporting project implementation.
Work with Operations, Planning, BI, and Tech teams to help deliver initiatives.
Prepare analyses, materials, and updates to support discussions and decision-making.


Requirements

Must have


Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Economics, or related fields.
1–3+ years of experience in consulting, operations, supply chain, analytics, or similar roles.
Strong problem-solving and logical thinking skills, able to break down complex problems and structure clear solutions
Ability to connect the dots across data, operations, and business context
Resilient and proactive, comfortable working in a fast-changing and sometimes ambiguous environment
Open-minded and adaptable, with a strong willingness to challenge existing ways of working and drive change
Strong analytical mindset with experience working with data and KPIs
Good communication skills in both Vietnamese and English


Nice to have


Experience in e-commerce, warehouse operations, or multi-region supply chains
Exposure to supply–demand planning, inventory optimization, or network-related topics
Experience working in cross-functional projects
Strong Excel / SQL / BI skills.

Experience with Python/R for data wrangling, forecasting, or experiment analysis.

locationDetails: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
jobDescription:
About the job

Objectives

We are looking for a data-driven and business-oriented Business Analyst – Media with strong analytical thinking and passion for digital marketing, media performance, and business optimization. You will play an important role in helping Media, Strategy, and Account teams make smarter decisions through actionable insights, reporting systems, and performance analysis. As part of the growing media and data ecosystem, you will help transform complex campaign data into meaningful business recommendations, optimize operational workflows, and improve overall marketing effectiveness.

Job Description


Media Performance Analysis Analyze campaign performance across digital platforms including Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, Ecommerce, and Programmatic channels. Monitor and evaluate key metrics such as CPM, CPC, CTR, CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, customer acquisition cost, retention, and funnel performance. Identify trends, anomalies, and optimization opportunities to improve media effectiveness and business outcomes. Conduct cross-channel analysis to evaluate media contribution toward overall business objectives. Support campaign forecasting, budget allocation analysis, and business performance evaluation.
Business Analysis & Reporting Collaborate with Media, Strategy, Account, Finance, and Tech teams to understand reporting requirements and business goals. Consolidate and structure data from multiple platforms and internal systems into unified reporting frameworks. Build and maintain dashboards, automated reports, and visualization systems using Excel, Google Sheets, Looker Studio, Power BI, or similar tools. Ensure reporting accuracy, consistency, and operational transparency across campaigns and business units. Develop data validation logic and reporting standards to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual errors. Proactively apply AI tools and technologies to automate workflows, improve reporting productivity, and optimize analytical processes.
Strategic Insights & Decision Support Translate raw campaign data into actionable business insights and recommendations. Conduct market, audience, and competitor analysis to support strategic planning and media recommendations. Partner with Media and Strategy teams to evaluate campaign effectiveness and identify growth opportunities. Support leadership teams with forecasting, business performance analysis, and ad-hoc analytical requests. Structure business problems into clear analytical frameworks and actionable solutions.
Operational Improvement & Collaboration Identify inefficiencies in reporting and operational workflows and propose optimization initiatives. Support teams in defining KPI frameworks and performance measurement standards. Create documentation, reporting guidelines, and analytical frameworks for internal stakeholders. Troubleshoot reporting discrepancies and support operational issue resolution related to data and reporting systems.


Job Requirements

Skills & Knowledge & Qualification


Minimum of 2–4 years of experience in Business Analysis, Media Analytics, Marketing Analytics, or related roles.
Strong understanding of Digital Marketing ecosystem and media performance metrics.
Experience working with digital advertising platforms such as Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, or Programmatic platforms.
Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for reporting and analytical purposes.
Experience with Looker Studio, Tableau, Power BI, SQL, or other data visualization/analytics tools is a strong plus.
Strong analytical thinking with the ability to interpret complex datasets and business problems.
Strong business acumen with the ability to connect media performance to business outcomes.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Strong problem-solving skills with high attention to detail and logical thinking.
Driven, self-motivated, proactive, and willing to continuously learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
Experience in Media Agency, Digital Agency, Ecommerce, or Marketing environment is highly preferred.
AI Mindset: Actively explore and apply AI tools to improve reporting workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance analytical productivity. Comfortable adapting to emerging technologies and integrating AI into daily working processes.


Benefits


Competitive salary range with quarterly incentives and 13th-month salary
Flexible working time with 4 days working from home per month and 15 paid leaves per year
Insurance as full salary (SHUI)
Annual health check-up and Healthcare Insurance VNI for all employees
Laptop supply/allowance or support for laptop purchase costs on an individual basis
Internal training & career development opportunities, and external L&D budget sponsorship
Team bonding budget quarterly, snack time to engage team members
Quarterly, Yearly Recognition Gifts & Awards and gifts on special occasions (birthday, New year…)
Holiday activities; Company trip; Year End Party; Company Birthday; Culture Day; Quarterly Town Hall.
Other staff welfare allowances.

title: Business Analyst-Trading
jobDescription:
About the job

About us




Bitget is the world's largest Universal Exchange (UEX), serving over 125 million users and offering access to over 2M crypto tokens, 100+ tokenized stocks, ETFs, commodities, FX, and precious metals such as gold. The ecosystem is committed to helping users trade smarter with its AI agent, which co-pilots trade execution.




Bitget is driving crypto adoption through strategic partnerships with LALIGA and MotoGP™. Aligned with its global impact strategy, Bitget has joined hands with UNICEF to support blockchain education for 1.1 million people by 2027. Bitget currently leads in the tokenized TradFi market, providing the industry's lowest fees and highest liquidity across 150 regions worldwide.




What you'll do




1. Maintain and reconcile core trading analytics frameworks across multiple asset classes (spot, perpetuals, futures, forex), ensuring consistency in data definitions, metric calculations, and reporting standards.




2. Lead technical analysis of trading parameters including funding rate mechanics, mark price methodology, ADL (Auto Deleveraging) trigger patterns, and unified margin model behavior.




3. Review comprehensive technical memos and analytical frameworks on trading operations, market microstructure, and liquidity dynamics; validate assumptions and methodologies.




4. Lead the adoption of new trading products and market structure changes; assess accounting and operational implications for user portfolios and risk calculations.




5. Act as the technical lead in responding to internal and external stakeholder inquiries regarding trading mechanics, fee structures, liquidation rules, and API rate limit impacts on business operations.







What you'll need




1. 5+ years of technical experience in trading analytics, quantitative analysis, or market operations with a verifiable track record of managing complex multi-asset trading data ecosystems.




2. Direct experience analyzing and optimizing trading mechanics across derivatives (perpetuals, futures) and spot markets; demonstrated ability to translate market microstructure into operational insights.




3. Expert-level knowledge of derivatives trading frameworks, particularly perpetual funding rates, mark price methodologies, unified margin models, and liquidation mechanics.




4. Significant tenure within a tier-1 crypto exchange, quantitative trading firm, market-making desk, or institutional trading operation; or equivalent experience at a traditional derivatives exchange or brokerage.




5. Proven experience as a key technical contributor to cross-functional trading operations projects, including liquidity provider optimization, risk analytics, or product mechanics analysis.




6. Advanced understanding of the technical and operational implications of on-chain trading mechanics, including gas fees, slippage dynamics, and blockchain-specific settlement considerations.







If you are ambitious and believe that digital assets could be the next financial and technological revolution, please apply!







For more information regarding candidates' personal data processing, please refer to Bitget Candidate Privacy Notice.

1. 5+ years of technical experience in trading analytics, quantitative analysis, or market operations with a verifiable track record of managing complex multi-asset trading data ecosystems.




2. Direct experience analyzing and optimizing trading mechanics across derivatives (perpetuals, futures) and spot markets; demonstrated ability to translate market microstructure into operational insights.




3. Expert-level knowledge of derivatives trading frameworks, particularly perpetual funding rates, mark price methodologies, unified margin models, and liquidation mechanics.




4. Significant tenure within a tier-1 crypto exchange, quantitative trading firm, market-making desk, or institutional trading operation; or equivalent experience at a traditional derivatives exchange or brokerage.




5. Proven experience as a key technical contributor to cross-functional trading operations projects, including liquidity provider optimization, risk analytics, or product mechanics analysis.




6. Advanced understanding of the technical and operational implications of on-chain trading mechanics, including gas fees, slippage dynamics, and blockchain-specific settlement considerations.







If you are ambitious and believe that digital assets could be the next financial and technological revolution, please apply!

jobDescription:
About the job
Mô tả công việc:- Thu thập, tìm hiểu nghiệp vụ và yêu cầu hệ thống từ phía khách hàng/nội bộ công ty- Hỗ trợ, khuyến nghị khách hàng trong việc định hướng yêu cầu của sản phẩm- Phân tích, đánh giá các đề xuất phát triển hệ thống của khách hàng- Tham gia vào quá trình triển khai dự án cùng với các bộ phận khác trong công ty- Thực hiện document lại các nghiệp vụ.- Tối ưu các luồng nghiệp vụ, quy trình- Báo cáo cho trưởng dự án, hoặc cấp quản lý trực tiếp- Tham gia kiểm thử chất lượng phần mềm, nghiệm thu sản phẩm trước khi thực hiện chuyển giao.- Thực hiện thêm một số task của PM nếu có yêu cầu- Làm việc onsite tại quận 7, HCM kết hợp làm HybridYêu cầu:- Ít nhất 3 năm làm BA trở lên- Tiếng anh giao tiếp tốt- Có kinh nghiệm về kỹ thuật phân tích dữ liệu- Có kỹ năng quản lý công việc, tư duy tốt.- Viết document tốt, trình bày khoa học, rõ ràng- Khả năng training tốt- Giao tiếp hòa nhã, ôn hòa- Kiên trì nhưng phải linh động khi cần thiết.Quyền lợi:- Mức lương khởi điểm hấp dẫn, cạnh tranh, tương xứng với năng lực và kinh nghiệm làm việc từ 20-27 triệu gross/tháng + phụ cấp onsite- Thu nhập: 13 tháng lương/năm + thưởng dự án lên đến 2 tháng lương/năm, thưởng Tết và các dịp lễ…- Xét tăng lương 2 lần/năm: 1 lần theo định kỳ và 1 lần đột xuất theo năng lực và hiệu quả công việc- Nghỉ thứ 7, Chủ nhật + Phép năm tối thiểu 12 ngày theo Quy định của Pháp luật hiện hành- Được tham gia bảo hiểm xã hội, bảo hiểm y tế, bảo hiểm thất nghiệp theo Quy định của Pháp luật hiện hành- Bảo hiểm chăm sóc sức khỏe- Được tham gia các Câu lạc bộ của Công ty: CLB Bóng đá, các CLB Cầu Lông…..- Được tham gia các hoạt động tập thể sôi động của công ty: Nghỉ mát hàng năm, Teambuilding hàng quý, Sinh nhật công ty, Gala cuối năm….- Có chính sách thăm hỏi ốm đau, thai sản, hiếu, hỉ, sinh nhật cho bản thân và người thân· Đặc biệt Được hỗ trợ 50% chi phí các khóa học bên ngoài, hỗ trợ 100% chi phí thi các chứng chỉ liên quan đến IT, các khóa học nâng cao kỹ năng mềm, thưởng từ 3 triệu đến 10 triệu khi hoàn thành chứng chỉ.

title: Strategy & Operations Associate / Manager (Vertical AI B2B - Hybrid)
jobDescription:
About the job
About MomosMomos is building AI agents for unforgettable hospitality. Our agents power the end-to-end guest experience for some of the largest hospitality brands in the world, including Burger King and Popeyes—helping them understand their guests, resolve issues, strengthen relationships, and improve operations across thousands of locations.We are an international company backed by leading global investors, and we are growing quickly.Vietnam is at the center of that growth. We are building what we call our AI Village: a dense community of exceptionally smart, hungry, and AI-native people who want to build category-defining products together. Vietnam is already our largest and fastest-growing office. It is not a satellite office or an outsourced delivery center—it is a core part of Momos' global strategy and where many of our most important teams and capabilities are being built.About The RoleWe are looking for a heat-seeking missile for pain.This is not a role with a neat box around it. You will go wherever the company's hardest and most important problems are, figure out what is actually happening, and help solve them.One month, you might launch a new operating process or help us enter a market. The next, you might diagnose why a key metric is underperforming, build the business case for a new initiative, unblock a cross-functional project, or turn a messy spreadsheet and five competing opinions into a clear decision.You do not need to come from one specific background. You might be an ex-consultant, banker, business analyst, product manager, startup operator, or simply an unusually capable generalist. We care less about the label on your previous job than whether you can think clearly, learn quickly, use AI fluently, and take complete ownership of difficult problems.This role is for someone who wants to eat, sleep, and breathe startups—not someone looking for a predictable lane or a perfectly defined job description.What You'll Do Find the highest-impact problems across the company and drive them through to resolutionBreak ambiguous questions into structured analyses, clear recommendations, and executable plansLead cross-functional initiatives spanning product, go-to-market, finance, customer operations, and international expansionBuild the models, dashboards, processes, and operating rhythms needed to help Momos scaleWork closely with company leadership to evaluate opportunities and make important decisionsUse AI aggressively to research, analyze, automate, prototype, and move fasterStep into operational gaps when something important does not yet have a clear owner
RequirementsExperience Associate: 1-3 years of experience in management consulting, investment banking or private equity, a business or product analyst role, or an operating role at a high-growth startupManager: 4-6 years in the same backgrounds, with a track record of owning ambiguous, cross-functional projects end-to-end and presenting directly to senior leadership — not just supporting someone else's initiative
Core Skills Strong written and spoken EnglishAdvanced Excel, plus working comfort with at least one data/BI tool (SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or similar)Demonstrated use of AI tools in day-to-day work — research, analysis, automation, or prototypingStrong analytical thinking combined with a bias toward action
You might be a fit if You are relentlessly resourceful and naturally gravitate toward difficult, messy problemsYou combine strong analytical thinking with a bias toward actionYou can move comfortably between strategy, data, process, and hands-on executionYou communicate clearly and can bring structure to people with different perspectivesYou learn unusually quickly and do not need extensive instructions before getting startedYou hold a high bar for your own work and are willing to do whatever the problem requiresYou are genuinely excited about AI and already use it to improve how you think and workYou want to build in person alongside an ambitious team in VietnamYou have experience in consulting, banking, business analysis, product, operations, or a high-growth startup—or can demonstrate equivalent horsepower through another path
What Success Looks LikeWithin your first year, you will have solved several problems that materially changed how Momos operates or grows. You will become someone leadership and teams trust with the company's most important, ambiguous, and cross-functional challenges.The scope and level of the role—Associate or Manager—will be calibrated to the experience and capabilities of the person we hire.BenefitsWhy Join Momos? Mission-driven, fast-paced, entrepreneurial environmentCollaborative, flat company cultureComprehensive private health insuranceDiscretionary trips to our offices worldwide, with global travel medical coverageCross-cultural team bonding and networking
Equal OpportunityMomos is an equal-opportunity workplace that embraces diversity and different cultures. We started as an international company and know that building an organization with diverse experiences, perspectives, and opinions allows our team to grow and excel.Love Food? Join our Team!

title: Lead Business Analyst
jobDescription:
About the job
About the jobFinX aims to build a digital financial product that will deliver on the promise of simplicity, technological advancement, and superior customer products & services for millions of people in Vietnam.As a Business Analyst Lead, you will lead the end-to-end business analysis process for our digital banking products by defining analysis standards, coordinating requirement elicitation and solution design activities, and ensuring comprehensive requirement coverage across complex banking workflows (payments, transfers, onboarding, eKYC, lending…). You will oversee requirement documentation, review BA deliverables, mentor BA team members, and collaborate closely with Product Managers, Development teams, QA, vendors, and third parties to ensure every release meets the highest standards of quality, accuracy, security, and regulatory compliance.Responsibilities Directly implement or support members in handling business requirements and change requests; lead requirement elicitation through interviews and deep-dive workshops with business users and stakeholders.Convert business needs into comprehensive documentation (BRD, URD, FSD, SRS, User Stories); define business rules, validation logic, and detailed functional specifications for development teams.Evaluate business needs to recommend optimal solutions, considering system capacity, ROI, and long-term scalability; seek and work with vendors, explain requirements, and compare solutions across functionality, cost, and delivery ability.Model business processes using BPMN and UML; define integration requirements between banking systems and third-party services (payment gateways, eKYC providers, card schemes…) via APIs and data flows.Assist the PM and Product Owner in defining UI/UX, mapping Customer Journeys, and managing product backlogs, timelines, and Change Requests (CR).Support SIT/UAT: develop business test cases, review test results against requirements, and obtain UAT sign-off.Maintain and update documents developed during requirement collection, analysis, and system design; conduct training/handover sessions for internal teams and IT Support on new system procedures.Lead and mentor a team; support planning and estimation of BA effort for assigned modules and report working results to line managers.
Qualification and Requirements Bachelor's degree or higher, preferably in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related technical disciplines.5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst / Business Systems Analyst, including 2+ years within banking, fintech, or financial services.Understanding of at least one BFSI domain: Digital Banking, Lending, Payments, eKYC, Card…Expertise in authoring BRD, FSD, SRS documents and User Stories; experience working in the full SDLC of projects/systems.Strong command of BPMN and UML (Activity, Sequence, State diagrams); experience with SQL (MySQL/Oracle/MSSQL) and Data Modeling is essential.Basic knowledge of UI/UX principles, APIs, and data flows; proficient with collaboration tools such as Jira and Confluence.Strong analytical thinking, keen attention to detail, presentation and workshop facilitation skills; proficient in change management and expectation management.
Nice to have Business Analyst certification (CBAP/CCBA or equivalent).Experience with Temenos T24 or other core banking platforms, including requirements elicitation, workshops, and fit-gap analysisExperience building a new system from scratch.Oracle PL/SQL skills (querying data, writing functions/stored procedures) and log analysis skills.
What can we offer? Attractive income (base salary & performance bonus) in Viet Nam fintech markets.Full-salary paid for social insurance & Premium healthcare package.Devices provided (MacBook, mouse, monitor…).
Location: PV Gas Tower, 673 Nguyen Huu Tho, Phuoc Kien Ward, Nha Be District, HCMC, Vietnam.

title: Business Analyst (Supply Analytics, Bangkok-based, Relocation provided)
jobDescription:
About the job
About AgodaAt Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.THIS ROLE IS BASED IN BANGKOK, THAILAND (WITH RELOCATION PROVIDED)Location: Bangkok, Thailand (*Not open for remote work)Get to Know our Team:As part of the Supply Analytics, you will be responsible for identifying new partners and opportunities, cultivating a relationship with them, and working together with them to deliver the best outcome for our end customers. You would also be responsible with managing the day-to-day interaction with the partner and working closely with other teams within Agoda to ensure the partners needs are met.We design tailored business and product solutions with our partners and help them generate measurable value. Members of our team are empowered and supported to grow their market(s) or accounts. We develop win-win relationships and leverage Agoda’s unique accommodations portfolio and tech solutions to bring our partners the advantages they seek. Utilizing our strong brand and resources, we build new channels to increase the visibility of Agoda, introduce more travelers to our great products and service and deliver significant revenues to the overall business.The Opportunity: As a Business Analyst, you will report directly to either the Senior Manager or Associate Director within the Supply Department and this will be an individual contributor role. You will be responsible and fully empowered to work with the partners on the ground. You will be supported by a team within the Supply department and work closely with other Team members within Agoda.In this Role, you’ll get to: Translate internal briefs into analytical projects (to include refining the initial brief and asking the ‘right questions’, working through potential hypotheses and storyboarding the output)Use and analyze data from multiple large-scale data warehouses and present statistically strong analysis to a wide range of business stakeholders.Proactively identify opportunities for growth within supply and the wider business.Drive new analytical initiatives and projects aimed at improving organizational efficiency and shaping Agoda supply.Identify, support, and lead projects aimed at scaling up the way the Supply organization leverages on data, insights, and intelligence.Automate manual operational processes and present back on time savings gained through modernization of business operations
What you’ll Need to Succeed: At least 2-5+ years of experience working as an Analyst with experience in analytics/data science/insights/strategy/BIAdvanced working knowledge and hands-on experience in SQLStrong knowledge and hands-on experience in data visualization tools such as Tableau (preferably) Expert domain of data analysis and data visualization tools and software such as Excel, Python (or R)Bachelor’s degree ideally in a business or quantitative subject (e.g. computer science, mathematics, engineering, science, economics or finance).A good understanding of statistical modelling knowledge or any machine learning technique knowledge (such as hypothesis testing, regression, logistic regression, random forest, etc.)Good stakeholder management experience. Comfortable presenting to senior leadership and C-suite.Experience in conducting A/B testing experimentationStrong experience in finding data insights and provide business recommendation to the businessA hacker’s mindset – the ability to build simple but clever and elegant solutions to new problems within significant resource, operational and time constraints through deep understanding of the business, creative problem solving, and a wide range of expertise in data, analytics, automation, programming, and prototyping.Excellent communicator with superior written, verbal, presentation and interpersonal communication skills.Data driven in both decision making and performance measurement.Extreme comfort in ambiguous, fast-paced environment.Ability to multi-task, prioritize and coordinate resources.
It’s Great if you Have: MBA or Masters in a quantitative subject (e.g. computer science, mathematics, engineering, science, economics or finance).Program management certifications (e.g. PMI, PRINCE2) to compliment your program management experience.Asian market experience.Travel industry / e-commerce / tech / consulting experience.

title: Senior Business Analyst (Monetization, Pricing, User)
locationDetails: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
jobDescription:
About the job
Company Description Chợ Tốt is part of Carousell Group, the fastest-growing classifieds technology group in Southeast Asia. Since launching in the Vietnamese market in 2013, Chợ Tốt has become a recommerce platform for buying and selling second-hand goods, with more than 10 million users and over 1 million items listed for resale every month. As Vietnam’s leading online classifieds site, we are passionate about making life more convenient for everyone.Our mission is to help everyone find a way to any of their wants (“Muốn là có”). We are a dynamic family with young and energetic members seeking motivated talents to join our fast-moving and fun-loving crew..For more information please visit https://careers.chotot.com/about-us/

title: Corporate Strategy Associate/Lead
jobDescription:
About the job
We are hiring a Corporate Strategy Associate/Lead to work directly on high-priority questions facing the business. You will move between market intelligence, and strategic projects, building the analysis and recommendations that inform decisions at the leadership and board level.This is a high-ownership role for someone with 2-3 years in a demanding analytical environment who wants broad exposure to how a leading regional e-commerce player is built and scaled. Expect to own workstreams end-to-end, present to senior stakeholders, and see your work translate into decisions.Responsibilities• Market intelligence: Build market and competitive intelligence on Southeast Asian e-commerce, platform dynamics (Shopee, TikTok Shop, Lazada), category trends, and competitor moves, and turn it into a clear point of view for leadership.• Strategic projects: Own strategic projects from problem definition to recommendation: structuring the question, gathering data, running the analysis, and packaging findings for executive audiences.• Business modeling: Build financial and operating models (e.g. market sizing, unit economics, brand and platform P&L, scenario analysis).• Communication: Assist in preparing board and leadership materials, and briefs for key customer and partnership meetings.• Cross-functional coordination: Partner across Commercial, Operations, Finance, and Data teams to source inputs, pressure-test assumptions, and drive initiatives to a decision.• Corporate development: Support corporate development: screen and evaluate acquisition, partnership, and new-market opportunities, including market sizing, business-case modeling, and due-diligence analysis• Operating cadence: Sharpen how the company runs: simplify cross-functional processes, strengthen the rhythm of planning and business reviews, and remove friction so decisions get made faster and initiatives move at pace.Qualifications• Experience: 2–3 years of experience in investment banking, management consulting, e-commerce, or a comparable analytical skillset.• Drive: High ownership and a bias toward getting things done in a fast-moving environment.• Comfort with ambiguity: Thrives amid shifting priorities and incomplete information; able to define structure and make progress without waiting for perfect data.• Analytical rigor: Strong quantitative and financial modeling skills; fluent in Excel, PowerPoint and comfortable building analysis from ambiguous or incomplete data.• AI toolkit: Strong capabilities and flexibility in using AI to improve your own and other’s productivity.• Problem-solving: Structured problem-solving — able to break down an open-ended question, form a hypothesis, and drive to an answer with limited direction.• Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication in English; able to build a compelling, executive-ready narrative (PowerPoint).

About the job
***Note: We highly appreciate your interest in this position of HCLTECH Vietnam. After reviewing all applications, only qualified candidates will be contacted for the next steps within 15 days from date of submission! ABOUT HCLTECH VIETNAM COMPANY LIMITED HCL Vietnam Company Limited belongs to HCLTech which is a global technology company, home to 220,000+ people across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering and cloud, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. Consolidated revenues as of 12 months ending Mar 31, 2025, totaled $13.8 billion. Website: https://www.hcltech.com/ Job title: NEO Agile Scrum Master (2-3 YOE Only)Job location: Ho Chi Minh City, VietnamJob summary:Our customer's Cross-Domain Computing & ADAS (XC-CP) Team is looking for full-time Embedded Security Engineer working at Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. The XC-CP Team develops high-quality, state-of-the-art Automotive Head Unit and Home Appliance Linux/Android-based systems.Together with other locations worldwide, we provide software solutions for navigation, vehicle functions, autonomous driving, camera, and IoT features to the car marker. title: Senior/Medior Business Analyst (English/French)
jobDescription:
About the job

About CBTW

CBTW is a global independent tech consultancy group. With a team of more than 3,000 talented tech specialists on the ground in over 35 cities across Europe, the USA, Asia, Australia and Africa, we serve clients of all sizes. We believe collaboration betters our world. Our unique open ecosystem model allows us to deliver end-to-end tech solutions.




We are looking for a Business Analyst, fluent in English and French, based in Vietnam.




Responsibilities

Gather, analyze, and validate business requirements from stakeholders.
Facilitate workshops and requirement discovery sessions.
Translate business needs into user stories, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria.
Document business processes, workflows, and functional requirements.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the project lifecycle.
Work independently, take ownership, and proactively drive analysis activities.




Qualifications

5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst in software development.
Excellent communication skills in English and French (mandatory).
Strong experience gathering, analyzing, validating, and documenting business and functional requirements.
Proven ability to facilitate workshops and communicate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
Hands-on experience writing User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and Functional Specifications.
Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

jobDescription:

The Business Analyst (Japanese Speaking) acts as a strategic liaison between business challenges and technology solutions. 2/ To thrive in this role, you need to have: Advanced understanding of business practices and processes.Excellent teamwork and client service orientation with strong organizational skills.3+ years of experience in roles such as Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Systems Analyst, Project Leader, or Project Manager.Strong knowledge of requirement documentation (BRD, SRS, FRS) and diagramming (roadmaps, organizational charts).Ability to work proactively in ambiguous situations and collaborate across departments.Must: Native/fluent Japanese (equivalent to N2 level) and proficiency in English for speaking, writing, and presenting.Prefer: Experience in Finance, Manufacturing, Logistics, Retail (FMCG, QSR, supermarkets, e-commerce), or related industries.Prefer: Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools like Azure DevOps.Prefer: Experience living or working in Japan.
Academic Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business, IT, or related field.Certifications in Business Analysis or Project Management are a plus.

title: Associate Manager, Agency Contest & Report
jobDescription:
About the job

Why Join Sun Life Vietnam?




At Sun Life, we cultivate a High-Performance, Caring Culture that empowers our people to achieve outstanding results, embrace continuous growth, and create meaningful impact. We succeed together by fostering an inclusive environment where wellbeing, collaboration, and accountability are equally valued.




About the Role




Support the end-to-end execution of Agency contests, including planning, communication, monitoring, cost tracking, and related logistics. Deliver Regional Office sales reports and supporting user acceptance testing (UAT) for automated reports to ensure accurate, timely, and business-relevant performance tracking for the Agency channel.




Responsibilities




Manage and monitor Agency contests by supporting end-to-end contests.
Planning, tracking, monitoring: Plan and update Agency contest tracking by reviewing contest performance, cost projections, and updated contest spend to support timely business decisions and budget control, monitor contest cost and payment readiness.
Communication: Prepare contest communication materials, including program memorandums, training materials, and responses to sales force questions; coordinate with peers and relevant teams to ensure clear and consistent implementation.
Logistic management: manage contest registration process, (noncash) payment contest payout progress.
Prepare regional sales reports and support automated report enhancement.
Preparing and maintaining regular Regional Office sales reports.
Developing and enhancing reports to support business monitoring and management review.
Supporting user acceptance testing for automated reports by validating report logic, checking data accuracy, and coordinating with Information Technology or relevant teams until resolution.




Qualifications




Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field. Minimum 2–3 years of relevant experience in reporting, planning, incentive operations, sales support, or insurance operations. Experience in data analysis and report preparation.




Required Skills




Good understanding of incentive program operations and sales performance analytics.
Good data handling and reporting skills, with attention to accuracy and timeliness.
Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word, Access, SQL.
Good coordination skills to collaborate across functions and drive timely follow-up of operational activities.
Good communication skills in Vietnamese and English.
Willingness to learn and apply artificial intelligence tools to improve work efficiency and data handling.




Preferred Skills




Analyse and resolve operational issues related to incentive programs, reporting, and system processes.
Work with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure timely issue resolution and process improvement.
Demonstrate strong ownership and accountability in problem solving.
Identify and resolve data discrepancies.

The private markets are a multi-trillion-dollar powerhouse that funds everything from tech startups to major infrastructure projects, yet much of it still operates on fragmented, inefficient legacy systems. At Anduin, we're changing that. The Anduin platform is built for the complete investor experience. We're not just improving a process; we're creating a better way for the entire industry to operate.The Anduin Platform has supported over $205 billion in capital raised, helping more than 1,180 funds and 64,000 investors transact in a more efficient and investor-friendly way. This remarkable traction is a testament to the powerful, tangible value we deliver to our clients every day, solidifying our position as a leader in the financial technology space.We're a global team of over 140 talented individuals with deep private market expertise across North America, Europe, and Asia. title: Senior Research Executive
jobDescription:
About the job
Numerator is a data company transforming how consumers and markets are understood. Powered by advanced technology and proprietary, zero-party purchase and survey data from more than one million households, Numerator provides visibility into consumer behavior and attitudes across consumer goods, retail, restaurants, tech and media, management consulting, institutional investors, and the public sector. Headquartered in Chicago, Numerator drives decisions at the world’s largest and fastest-growing companies in more than 50 countries.Role purpose:Are you inquisitive, creative, hardworking, and driven?If you are, we are looking for a Senior Research Executive to be part our team passionate about bringing compelling levels of insights to our partners, and ensuring the long-term revenue growth for Worldpanel Vietnam.This is an exciting role which will provide you with a blended development focus from on-the-job experience, exposure and exchange of knowledge with others, and more formal education as you look to take the next step in your career.WHAT YOU’LL DO:Prepare presentations & recommendations to clients based on Worldpanel research results to help them with their marketing strategies.Initiate and build client relationship, handle daily client requests, and anticipate client demands to proactively find solutions.Support line managers in identifying further opportunities within client portfolio to generate business revenue streams.Coordinate relevant training activities for clients to provide them with deep understanding of consumer behaviors.Ownership of all legal documents for your client.WHAT YOU’LL BRING: 2-3 years of working experience in Research or Marketing– ideally in FMCG industry.Strong numerical and analytical skills which can be applied in a commercial context with an interest in analyzing data to provide recommendations and insight.A curious mentality and unafraid to have a point of view.Able to cope well with tight deadlines and make decisions under complex and fast paced circumstances.Excellent client servicing skills and enjoys establishing relationships.Well organized with strong level of time management and the ability to effectively plan the workload for own and a small team.Professional and courteous in manner, dedicated to providing a good level of service and motivated to find solutions for problems.Articulate and credible written and verbal communication skills, including good presentation skills.Be able to work effectively in a team environment and independently.Business minded and determined with passion to learn, contribute and to develop.Good command of computer skills, proficient in MS PowerPoint, Excel and Word.Demonstrates intellectual and professional integrity.Knowledge of various statistical and analytical techniques and/or tools is an advantage.
WHAT WE OFFER: Attractive annual leave (15 days in the first year and 20 days from the second year)Private health insurance coverageFlexible working arrangementsEmployee Assistance Program (EAP) to support mental health and wellbeingRecognition programsCelebration of major festivals.

title: Senior Business Analyst
jobDescription:
About the job
LARION is a global software outsourcing partner with nearly two decades of industry expertise. We are a 100% Vietnamese technology company that specializes in turnkey solutions and the formation of highly skilled development teams for businesses of all sizes and industries. LARION, led by a team of successful entrepreneurs and dedicated technical experts, is a one-of-a-kind symphony in which we passionately create a frictionless future for customers while adhering to your exact needs and objectives.We are looking for an experienced Senior Business Analyst with strong Presales and Solution Consulting capabilities to bridge business needs and technology solutions. In this role, you will engage with clients to understand business challenges, shape solution proposals, facilitate requirement discovery, and collaborate with delivery teams to ensure successful implementation.As part of our AI-driven transformation, you are expected to leverage emerging AI technologies to improve business analysis, accelerate solution design, and deliver greater value to clients.I. Key Responsibilities Business Analysis Elicit, analyze, validate, and document business, functional, and non-functional requirements.Translate business needs into user stories, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, process flows, and solution documentation.Facilitate workshops, requirement discovery sessions, and stakeholder interviews.Analyze business processes and recommend technology-driven improvements.Support UAT planning, execution, and solution validation.
Presales & Solution Consulting Work closely with the Sales and Presales teams to understand client needs and propose appropriate technology solutions.Participate in client meetings, discovery workshops, solution presentations, and proposal preparation.Collaborate with Solution Architects and technical teams to define solution scope, high-level architecture, and implementation approach.Prepare functional solution overviews, effort assumptions, and project scope during the presales phase.Support RFI/RFP responses, solution demonstrations, and proof-of-value discussions when required.
Project Delivery Manage requirement changes and ensure alignment between business expectations and technical implementation.Support project planning, estimation, risk identification, and stakeholder communication.
AI Adoption Leverage Generative AI tools to improve business analysis, documentation, requirement management, and productivity.Identify opportunities where AI technologies can create business value and enhance client solutions.Stay up to date with emerging AI trends and evaluate their applicability to business and technology solutions.
II. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.Minimum 06 years of experience as a Business Analyst in software development, enterprise applications, or digital transformation projects; experience in Presales, Solution Consulting, or Project Management is a strong advantage.Strong knowledge of SDLC, Agile/Scrum methodologies, business analysis best practices, and experience in requirements elicitation, business process analysis, stakeholder management, and workshop facilitation.Good understanding of software architecture, system integration, RESTful APIs, databases, SQL, cloud technologies, and the ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, Solution Architects, and Engineering teams.Excellent analytical thinking, communication, presentation, negotiation, consulting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into practical technology solutions.Hands-on experience with collaboration and business analysis tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Miro, Figma, Visio, or similar. Experience preparing solution proposals, SOWs, solution presentations, or supporting RFI/RFP responses is an advantage.Practical experience using Generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot) to improve business analysis, documentation, productivity, and solution design. Familiarity with LLMs, AI Agents, Prompt Engineering, or RAGProfessional certifications such as CBAP, PMI-PBA, PMP, Scrum Master, or equivalent are a plus.
III. Why Join LARION?1. Workplace Join a vibrant team working on cutting-edge projects.Collaborate with global experts to enhance your skills.Thrive in a culture of openness and respect that encourages your full potential.
2. Benefits Competitive salary, 13th-month salary, and performance-based bonuses.Comprehensive healthcare package, including statutory and accident insurance.Meal allowance and additional benefits for marriage, newborn, bereavement, and other life events.Access to Coursera and Udemy Business Premium, along with continuous English, technical, and soft skills training.Annual company trips, team-building activities, sports clubs (badminton, football, yoga, etc.), and vibrant employee engagement events.Recognition and rewards through quarterly, annual, team, individual, and long-service awards.Modern workplace with a fully stocked pantry and all necessary working equipment provided from day one.Engaging monthly events: Happy gatherings, mini-games, team birthdaycelebrations, year-end party, and more.Employee support fund for personal loans (e.g., housing, vehicle, education).Clear career development opportunities in a fast-growing technology company.
IV. Additional Information Location: QTSC1 Building, Quang Trung Software City, Trung My Tay Ward, (District 12), Ho Chi Minh CityWorking Hours: Monday to Friday: 08:30 AM - 06:00 PM (with a 1.5-hour lunch break).
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and understood ourPrivacy Policy. You hereby consent to the collection, use, processing, and retention of your personal data for the recruitment purposes described in the Privacy Policy (https://larion.com/privacy-policy/)
