title: Manager, Data Reporting & Insights
jobDescription:
About the job
ABOUT THE JOB At NAB Vietnam, we are on an exciting transformation journey to build a modern data and analytics ecosystem that accelerates operational performance, deepens customer understanding, and drives productivity improvements across the organization As the Manager, Reporting & Insights, you will play a critical leadership role in establishing and advancing our enterprise reporting and analytics capability. You will help shape a centralized data foundation, creating a trusted single source of truth while ensuring data quality, accessibility, and governance across the business Leading a team of data professionals, you will deliver meaningful reporting, analytics, and insights that provide clear visibility into performance, risks, and opportunities. Partnering closely with business and technology stakeholders, you will translate complex data into actionable insights that support strategic decision-making and business outcomes. YOUR JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Lead and develop a team of data analysts and engineers to deliver high-quality reporting and insights. Develop analytics, dashboard reporting for dedicated executives and functional leaders, foster trust in data by applying data risk governance principles. Leverage insights from data to anticipate future requirements to support decision making. Partner with stakeholders to define, track and enhance performance metrics, ensuring alignment to business priorities. Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights that inform decision making and highlight risks and opportunities. Ensure data quality, governance and consistency across reporting outputs. Provide people leadership including performance management, quarterly check-ins and end-of-year outcomes, fostering an engaged and high-performing team culture. title: Senior Product Data Analyst, Zalo Business Solutions
requirementsSummary: What you will need At least 4 years in data analytics or business intelligence, including ownership of a data model or reporting layer that other teams relied on;Strong data modeling skills (dimensional and star schema, semantic layers) and experience defining governed, consistent metrics as a single source of truth;Advanced SQL;Strong analytical thinking and business judgment, with the ability to own deeper analysis as the role grows;Analytics design: shaping existing data into the right metrics and specifying new tracking when needed;Experience with AI-assisted or automated reporting, or a strong drive to build it: comfortable prompting AI tools, giving them the right context, and checking their output;Has owned an analytics or reporting project end to end and communicates clearly with engineering, product, and business. People management is not required.

Nice to have Python for data analysis and automation (for example Pandas);Hands-on experience with Apache Superset, Power BI, Tableau, or Metabase;Experience making data ready for AI tools, such as semantic layers, documentation, or text to SQL;Experience across both product analytics and business or commercial data;Experience with large scale data environments, or with B2B.
responsibilitiesSummary: Zalo Business Solutions (ZBS) is Zalo comprehensive suite of solutions that empowers businesses to operate, advertise, and serve customers effectively within the Zalo ecosystem. Our mission is to provide standardized and scalable tools that help enterprises and SMEs reach customers securely and optimize automated engagement workflows.We are hiring a Senior Product Data Analyst to own the data foundation behind ZBS: the data model, the metric definitions, and the accuracy of the numbers we make decisions on. You will also build the reporting that runs on top of it, where better data lets AI deliver more, not just faster. This is a hands-on senior role with a lot of autonomy, sitting within a product team with engineering support for the pipeline work. Your first focus is to enhance the existing foundation and reporting so they are AI-ready. As the platform matures, you will grow into deeper analysis and decision support.What you will doBuild the data foundation and metrics Shape data that is already collected into clean, well defined metrics that product and business teams can trust;Define and document the data model so metrics stay consistent across ZBS. When something is not yet captured, write the tracking specification and work with the PO and engineer to add it;

Build the reporting layer (primary focus) Build and tune reporting that produces accurate dashboards, clear narratives, and useful guidance on what is going well and what needs attention, using AI to generate it;Automate recurring reporting and cut the manual effort behind it, bringing in the business context the numbers need to make sense;Keep the data model and metric definitions documented and rich enough for AI to produce correct, consistent output, and own how reporting is done for the team;

Turn data into decisions (grows over time) Investigate the why behind the numbers and turn it into clear recommendations the team can act on;Run funnel, cohort, retention, and segmentation analyses, and measure the impact of changes with A/B tests or before-and-after comparisons;Use AI to surface and explain routine patterns, and dig in yourself on the questions that need real analysis;Be the data partner that product and business teams rely on when making decisions.

We're growing our SEA presence and want youto join us as a cornerstone of our team.Who We AreFounded and headquartered in Paris, Artefact is a next-generation consulting firmspecializing in data, analytics, and AI consulting — dedicated to transforming data intobusiness impact across the entire value chain of organizations. We don't just advise; webuild, implement, and deliver results our clients can measure.We have 2,500 employees across 36 offices focused on accelerating digitaltransformation for some of the world's most recognizable brands. Our state-of-the-artdata technologies, lean AI agile methodologies, and cohesive teams of elite businessconsultants, data analysts, data scientists, data engineers, and digital experts are alllaser-focused on delivering real value to every client. We design data-driven solutionstailored to each client's specific needs — always conceived with a business-first mindset and delivered with tangible, measurable results. Our expertise is built on deep AIknowledge acquired through 1,000+ client engagements across the globe.Find out more at artefact.com.What you will be doingAs a Senior Data Analyst, you will work at the intersection of data, technology, andbusiness, turning complex datasets into actionable insights for our clients.Your key responsibilities will include: Defining client needs through in-depth discovery – conducting structured interviews and needs assessments with client teams across business units to surface the real problem beneath the stated onePerforming advanced data analysis and rigorous research to solve high impact, strategic challenges that matter to our clients’ bottom lineBuilding, formulating and presenting data driven strategic recommendations that are compelling, actionable and boardroom-readyContributing to business proposals that win – translating Artefact’s capabilities into clear, persuasive value propositions for prospective clients across SEAWorking across cross-functional teams to drive implementation of recommendations that drive meaningful changeTaking ownership of project delivery – ensuring workstreams are aligned, on schedule, and meeting client expectations, with support from a Manager or Director

As a member of our team, you'll help definewhat excellence looks like at Artefact in this market. We'll give you the platform and thetools to do your best work — and you'll arrive ready with the following: Undergraduate degree with strong academic performance; advanced degree (MBA or MSc in a quantitative field) is a significant assetMinimum 2-3 years of full-time experience in one or more of the following: consulting, data/analytics, marketing, finance, or tech — with a clear track record of client-facing delivery and independent problem-solvingExceptional verbal and written communication skills; you can represent Artefact with confidence and credibility at the senior client levelDemonstrated ability to lead and collaborate across diverse, multicultural teams; strong intercultural communication skills are essential in our global environmentAdvanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; Prior experience with either SQL, Python, or R is a mustExperience with data visualization tools, such as Tableau, Power BI, Google Analytics is a strong differentiatorGenuine passion for data, digital, and the broader tech and AI economy — you follow this space because you love it, not because you have toA natural teaching orientation and demonstrated ability to mentor junior team members; you make the people around you betterDeep knowledge of strategy consulting and/or digital marketing — within a consultancy, start-up, or agency — is highly desirable
Why You Should Join UsAt this stage in your career, you have options. Here's what makes Artefact different:Real ownership, right away. We're building our SEA practice, which means yourcontributions don't disappear into a bureaucracy — they shape the trajectory of anentire market. The decisions you make now will define how Artefact grows across SEA.Work that's actually at the frontier. Our clients aren't asking yesterday's questions.You'll be tackling problems where AI and advanced analytics are actively reshapingindustries — and you'll be expected to contribute to conversations with SEA’s mostambitious organizations.A global network that makes you better. With 36 offices worldwide, you'll tap intomethodologies, expertise, and colleagues across every major market. Our scale givesyou resources; our culture gives you autonomy. You'll bring global best practices to theSEA market — and contribute SEA’s insights back to the world.We are united by our values and strengthened by our hybrid expertise: There is always a way — We're builders, diggers, and makers. Ideas only count if they get executed.Client trust is won in the field — We show up where it matters, working side by side with our clients to solve what's real.If not used, it is useless — We build for adoption and impact. True brilliance is measured by what changes, not what's delivered.If not shared, our work is not done — Sharing knowledge is how we close the loop — for our clients and for each other.We learn every day — In a field moving at the speed of light, intellectual curiosity isn't optional. It's survival.

title: Senior Data Analyst
jobDescription:
About the job
Timo's data volume and stakeholder demand are growing faster than the current Data Analyst team's capacity, driven by expansion across lending (PayLater/Timo Credit), deposits (GoalSave, Term Deposit, CD), and payments.This role creates a senior layer within the team: a technically strong analyst who can own complex, ambiguous problems end-to-end, represent data insights directly to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, and manage a small pod of junior analysts — freeing the Head of Data to focus on strategic and cross-departmental priorities.A day in your life might include1. Data Analysis & Technical Delivery• Own end-to-end analysis for high-priority initiatives (e.g., lending, deposits, cards, new user onboarding), from framing the business question to delivering the recommendation.• Write efficient, well-documented SQL and Python (pandas) to extract, clean, and model data from the Group's warehouse (Athena, dbt).• Build and maintain dashboards and self-serve reporting (Holistic Dashboard) that reduce ad-hoc requests to the team.• Design and evaluate experiments (A/B tests), cohort, funnel, and segmentation analyses to support product and growth decisions.• Own, set, and enforce data quality, documentation, and analytical rigor standards and event tracking across the team's outputs.2. Insight Generation & Stakeholder Communication• Translate complex, technical analysis into clear, decision-ready narratives for non-technical audiences, including senior management.• Present findings and recommendations directly to stakeholders across Product, Business, Risk, and Compliance — including trade-offs, confidence levels, and limitations.• Partner with Product and Business teams to define success metrics and KPIs for new initiatives before launch, not just measure them after.• Proactively surface trends, risks, and opportunities from data, rather than only responding to inbound requests.3. title: Graphic Designer
jobDescription:
About the job
About UsWe are a fast-growing US-based e-commerce company specializing in premium home theater seating and automotive furniture under the Seatcraft and Qualitex brands. We sell across our own websites and major marketplaces, and we're building out our Ho Chi Minh City office as a key part of our global team. You'll work closely with our Vietnam colleagues and collaborate daily with our design and marketing team in the United States.The RoleWe're looking for a talented Graphic Designer who brings a sharp modern aesthetic and a forward-thinking approach to design. You'll create visuals across e-commerce, digital marketing, email campaigns, social media, and product presentation — work that reaches hundreds of thousands of customers.This isn't a traditional design job. We expect you to be fluent in AI tools and use them actively as part of how you work — not as a novelty, but as a genuine part of your creative process.What You'll Do Design graphics for product pages, email marketing, paid ads (Google, Meta), and social mediaCreate promotional banners, lifestyle visuals, and brand assets for our Shopify-based websites and Amazon storesBuild and maintain email design templates in KlaviyoCollaborate with our US-based design, marketing, and product teams across time zonesIterate quickly on creative concepts using a blend of Figma and AI-assisted workflowsMaintain a consistent, clean, and modern visual brand across all touchpoints
What We're Looking For Figma is your primary tool — you're fast, organized, and build clean component-based filesAI is part of your daily workflow — you actively use tools like Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, ChatGPT, or similar to ideate, generate, and refine visualsFamiliarity with Shopify and designing within its ecosystemExperience with or willingness to learn Klaviyo for email template designA modern, clean aesthetic — your portfolio reflects contemporary design sensibilities: sharp layouts, intentional typography, refined use of colorStrong written English communication skills for cross-team collaborationSelf-motivated and comfortable working in a growing, fast-paced environmentE-commerce or product design experience is a plus
What We Offer A collaborative, international team environmentReal creative ownership — your work is seen by real customers, not stuck in a drawerOpportunity to grow with a company expanding its Vietnam presenceCompetitive compensation

title: Commercial Analyst - Pricing & Costing
jobDescription:
About the job

Job Description Summary

The AKA Commercial Analyst, Pricing & Costing will support the AKA Commercial Leader, Pricing & Costing in driving governance, standardization, and execution excellence across high-impact commercial opportunities. The role is responsible for conducting pricing and costing analyses, supporting deal reviews, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, and maintaining effective commercial governance processes. Through strong financial acumen and attention to detail, the analyst will help enable timely deal closure while ensuring compliance with internal policies, Delegation of Authority (DOA) requirements, and established commercial review processes.

GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities


 Deal Project Management & Execution
Support the Commercial Leader - Pricing & Costing in managing Pricing & Costing analysis of key strategic deals and business-critical projects.
Monitor the deal pipeline across current and upcoming quarters, proactively identifying priorities and facilitating readiness discussions.
Coordinate internal deal preparation activities, including cost sheet reviews and cross-functional alignment among Commercial, Product, Finance, OTR, HPM, and other stakeholders.

title: Senior Business Analyst - Data & AI
jobDescription:
About the job

Are you passionate about helping organizations unlock business value through data, analytics, and AI?

Do you enjoy working with business leaders and technical teams to transform complex challenges into innovative data-driven solutions?

Are you excited by the opportunity to shape AI, analytics, and digital transformation initiatives within one of Vietnam's fastest-growing markets?

 

At SoftwareOne, we help organizations harness the power of data, AI, and cloud technologies to accelerate business transformation. We are looking for a Senior Business Analyst – Data & AI to act as the bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams, ensuring that data, analytics, and AI solutions deliver measurable business outcomes for our customers.

 

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will work closely with clients, architects, data engineers, and project teams to shape and deliver Data & AI initiatives. Leveraging your strong understanding of the Vietnam market and banking industry, you will help customers identify business opportunities, define requirements, and translate strategic objectives into scalable data and AI solutions.

 

Key responsibilities:

Leading discovery workshops and stakeholder engagements to gather, analyze, and prioritize business requirements for Data & AI initiatives.
Defining functional specifications, user stories, process flows, data requirements, and business rules that guide solution delivery.
Partnering with customers to identify, evaluate, and prioritize data, analytics, AI, and GenAI use cases that deliver measurable business value.
Acting as the liaison between business and technical teams, ensuring alignment throughout the delivery lifecycle.
Supporting user acceptance testing, data validation, and solution adoption activities to ensure successful outcomes.
Contributing to proposals, solution scoping, and client engagements while helping shape SoftwareOne's Data & AI offerings within the Vietnam market.
Job Requirements 
Experience working as a Business Analyst on Data, Analytics, AI, or digital transformation initiatives.
Strong understanding of business process analysis, requirements management, and stakeholder engagement.
Knowledge of modern data and analytics platforms, cloud technologies, and business intelligence solutions.
Experience working with banking or financial services organizations and understanding of the regulatory and operational landscape.
Excellent communication skills in both Vietnamese and English, with the ability to engage effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and facilitation skills with a proactive and customer-focused mindset.
Company description 

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI. 

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference. 

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

title: Managing Consultant, Advisor & Consulting Service , Deploy
jobDescription:
About the job

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Managing Consultant, Advisor & Consulting Service , Deploy

Overview

Make an Impact as a Managing Consultant, Deploy is an execution-oriented, client-facing competency that applies proven program management, change capabilities, and domain expertise to partner with clients and drive measurable value by:


 Delivering new products and strategies to market smoothly and efficiently
 Successfully implementing complex technology assets and leading large-scale transformation programs to create the new business as usual
 Strengthening client’s internal skills, knowledge and experience in critical areas
 Transforming client processes and optimizing their management practices
 Owning end-to-end delivery outcomes and driving measurable business impact across the full lifecycle of client initiatives
 Acting as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders to influence decisions and maximize value realization



________________________________________

All About The Role

Deploy is a suite of consulting solutions designed to respond to fast evolving customer needs for execution support, with a dual mission: deployment and value realization over the entire lifetime of major assets. Value realization is a complex task, and Deploy helps de-risk the entire client/asset journey—from implementation to adoption, usage, and product evolution—through expert execution support that complements traditional Advisors capabilities.

As a Managing Consultant, you will lead complex programs and/or multiple engagements independently, providing direction and leadership across a portfolio of work. You will drive efficient and effective execution of a broad range of activities by establishing clear governance, defining team structures, and aligning stakeholders to deliver expected business outcomes.

You Will


 Lead end-to-end program delivery across multiple workstreams, ensuring alignment to strategic client objectives
 Own governance, execution planning, and delivery tracking across complex initiatives
 Drive alignment across senior stakeholders, manage escalations, and ensure timely decision-making
 Proactively identify and mitigate risks, ensuring minimal impact on timelines and program outcomes
 Ensure delivery translates into measurable value realization and sustainable business impact
 Contribute to business development by identifying opportunities to expand engagements and support proposal development



All About You


 Undergraduate degree with work experience in project management and change management methodologies and techniques
 6+ years of Project Management experience
 Exposure to financial institutions, payments, and/or consultancies
 Experience coaching and managing teams across multiple projects and/or engagements with third parties
 Experience managing key client relationships
 Knowledge of business KPIs, financials, and organizational leadership
 Ability to provide perspective on industry and marketplace
 Logical, structured thinking
 Advanced Word, Excel, and PowerPoint skills
 Ability to manage multiple tasks and clients in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
 Ability to communicate effectively in English and the local office language (if applicable)
 Eligibility to work in the country where you are applying, as well as apply for travel visas as required by travel needs
 Ability to travel to client sites on a semi-regular basis



Preferred Qualifications


 Exposure to payments ecosystem including issuing, acquiring, or acceptance solutions, with preference for candidates with hands-on acquiring experience (e.g., merchant acquiring, payment gateways, POS solutions, or acceptance networks)
 Experience leading development and implementation of solutions and measuring impact on clients' business
 Have completed or interested in pursuing recognized professional accreditation, such as Project Management Professional (PMP)
 Knowledge of Project Management tools
 Exposure to payments and/or retail banking or merchants
 Experience generating new knowledge or creating innovative solutions for a firm
 MBA or master’s degree with relevant specialization (not required)



Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:


Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Graphic Designer
jobDescription:
About the job

About Us




We are a fast-growing US-based e-commerce company specializing in premium home theater seating and automotive furniture under the Seatcraft and Qualitex brands. We sell across our own websites and major marketplaces, and we're building out our Ho Chi Minh City office as a key part of our global team. You'll work closely with our Vietnam colleagues and collaborate daily with our design and marketing team in the United States.




The Role




We're looking for a talented Graphic Designer who brings a sharp modern aesthetic and a forward-thinking approach to design. You'll create visuals across e-commerce, digital marketing, email campaigns, social media, and product presentation — work that reaches hundreds of thousands of customers.




This isn't a traditional design job. We expect you to be fluent in AI tools and use them actively as part of how you work — not as a novelty, but as a genuine part of your creative process.




What You'll Do




Design graphics for product pages, email marketing, paid ads (Google, Meta), and social media
Create promotional banners, lifestyle visuals, and brand assets for our Shopify-based websites and Amazon stores
Build and maintain email design templates in Klaviyo
Collaborate with our US-based design, marketing, and product teams across time zones
Iterate quickly on creative concepts using a blend of Figma and AI-assisted workflows
Maintain a consistent, clean, and modern visual brand across all touchpoints







What We're Looking For




Figma is your primary tool — you're fast, organized, and build clean component-based files
AI is part of your daily workflow — you actively use tools like Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, ChatGPT, or similar to ideate, generate, and refine visuals
Familiarity with Shopify and designing within its ecosystem
Experience with or willingness to learn Klaviyo for email template design
A modern, clean aesthetic — your portfolio reflects contemporary design sensibilities: sharp layouts, intentional typography, refined use of color
Strong written English communication skills for cross-team collaboration
Self-motivated and comfortable working in a growing, fast-paced environment
E-commerce or product design experience is a plus







What We Offer




A collaborative, international team environment
Real creative ownership — your work is seen by real customers, not stuck in a drawer
Opportunity to grow with a company expanding its Vietnam presence
Competitive compensation
